title: The radical of a homogeneous ideal is homogeneous
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field] and let $R= \bigoplus_{d\ge0}R_d$ be a standard graded $k$-algebra [def-pc-standard-graded-algebra], in particular a commutative ring graded by the nonnegative integers: every element has a unique finite sum of components in the additive subgroups $R_d$, $1\in R_0$, and $R_aR_b\subseteq R_{a+b}$. Let $J\subseteq R$ be a homogeneous ideal, meaning that each homogeneous component of every element of $J$ belongs to $J$. Then the radical ideal $\sqrt J=\{r\in R:r^h\in J\text{ for some integer }h\ge1\}$ is homogeneous.
